newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona cargo traffic rose 9 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona cargo traffic rose 9 pct in September.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport increased 8.58 percent in September compared with the same month last year to 6,355 tonnes, the airport authority said.
The total for the first nine months of 1996 now stands at 56,279 tonnes, 16.97 percent above the same period 1995.
Domestic cargo business declined 8.54 percent in the month to 2,559 tonnes while international traffic rose 24.27 percent to 3,796 tonnes.
Passenger numbers were 13.53 percent higher in September at 1.23 million excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 9.77 million, a rise of 13.50 percent.
